breaking_risk: zero (additive only; existing public API preserved)
honest_c3: FIX-1: HEAD vs GET headers may differ on S3/CDN edges (Content-Length omission on chunked streaming).
FIX-1: 405 Method Not Allowed possible from buggy servers; status returned as-is.
FIX-1: ASCII-only header lowercasing (RFC token chars are ASCII; Unicode header names pass through).

FIX-2: http_get_with_headers_status does not surface response headers, so GET retry path uses local schedule even when server emits Retry-After. HEAD path honors it. Phase-2 stdlib/http API extension required.
FIX-2: backoff caps at 16s x 5 attempts ~31s; pathological 5-min throttles still surface as final 429.
FIX-2: sleep capped at 60s per call to prevent malicious Retry-After: 86400 stalling.
FIX-2: no jitter; thundering-herd against same shard mostly self-cures via per-token rate-limit.
FIX-3: per-chunk sha256 NOT performed (HF Hub does not advertise per-chunk hashes); final-file sha256 vs x-linked-etag remains sole source of truth.
FIX-3: no incremental resume across process restarts; each call truncates and redownloads from offset 0.
FIX-3: sequential chunks only (no parallel chunk fetch); speedup comes from per-chunk 429 isolation not parallelism.
FIX-3: append via `>>` shell assumes single-writer per path; concurrent writers to same output would interleave on NFS without locking.
